summary: In the learning-map view of the knowledge graph the left list now works like in the paper view: picking a paper locates its node (it and what is connected stay lit, the rest dims, the camera centres on it) and picking a category lights that category's papers and the units they fit. The two switches on the graph (view; which papers) are drawn as proper pills: the page-wide button style no longer shows through inside them. The paper view gets its own hint line back after the learning-map view wrote one.

budget_impact.rationale: Class changes and camera moves in the browser only; no model call, no network, nothing stored.
budget_impact.before: the left list did nothing useful in the learning-map view; the switches had a border inside the pill
budget_impact.after: the left list locates nodes; the switches are pills
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.command: browser preview on a seeded copy
additional_checks.scope: clicked a paper in the left list in the learning-map view: node ringed, its unit lit, others dimmed; pills look right; hint line restored when switching back

open_risks: Picking a category in the learning-map view was tested with a headless graph, not clicked in the browser.
The desktop app was not rebuilt for this change.
